function-model.def: A function chosen to describe how one quantity in a real situation depends on another, such as h(t) for height after t seconds. It is chosen from the pattern in the data and from the context, and used to predict and explain.

model-assumption.def: A condition a function model takes for granted, such as a sheet having no thickness or a rate staying constant. Assumptions include the restricted domain (or contextual domain) and range: only the inputs and outputs the situation allows.
